title: Reduction of cohomology vanishing to finitely generated constant subsheaves
statement: Let X be a quasi-compact topological space whose quasi-compact open subsets form a basis and are closed under pairwise intersection. Let d be a nonnegative integer. For a quasi-compact open inclusion j:U\to X put E_U=j_!\underline{\mathbf Z}_U, using the constant sheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf] and extension by zero [lem-sc-topological-extension-by-zero-stalks]. Assume H^p(X,E_U)=0 for all p>d and all such U. Assume also that H^q(X,K)=0 for every q>d and every abelian sheaf K admitting a monomorphism K\to\underline{\mathbf Z}_X and an epimorphism \bigoplus_{i=1}^n E_{U_i}\to K for some finite family of quasi-compact opens U_i (including n=0). Then H^p(X,F)=0 for every abelian sheaf F and every p>d, with cohomology as in [def-sc-topological-abelian-cohomology].

proof.text: For an epimorphism E_U to G, choose its kernel K. The proved integer-extension monomorphism embeds K into the constant integer sheaf. Exhaust K by a directed diagram of finitely generated subsheaves. Each stage satisfies hsub in degree p+1, via the composite of its monomorphism into K, the kernel inclusion, and E_U into the constant sheaf. The filtered-cohomology comparison identifies H^(p+1)(X,K) with the colimit of these zero groups, so it is zero.

Apply Ext.covariant_sequence_exact3 to the short exact kernel sequence 0 to K to E_U to G to 0. Its degree-p middle cohomology is zero by hvanish and the following degree-(p+1) kernel cohomology is zero by the preceding step. Each class of H^p(X,G) consequently lifts from a zero group, hence is zero. This proves vanishing for all one-generator quotients. The private exact-sequence helper is proved for every open U and specialized to U = X here.

Induct on the finite coproduct size n. For n=0 the epimorphism from the empty coproduct is zero and its target is zero. For n+1 generators let gfirst be the map from the first n summands, let A be its image and Q the cokernel of the image inclusion into F. The first n generators epimorphically generate A, so induction gives its vanishing. The last summand maps epimorphically to Q: any map from Q annihilating that summand annihilates every generator, hence is zero by cancellation of the original epimorphism and the cokernel epimorphism. Step 2 gives vanishing for Q. Ext.covariant_sequence_exact2 for 0 to A to F to Q to 0 gives vanishing for F. The private exact-sequence helper is proved for every open U and specialized to U = X here.

Exhaust the original sheaf F by the finitely generated diagram. Step 3 makes every stage cohomology zero. Apply the filtered-cohomology comparison in degree p over the compact whole space; the colimit of the zero diagram is zero, and transport across the comparison and the colimit-cocone isomorphism gives the stated vanishing for F.
